concepts.label: Help
concepts.definition: Providing assistance; directional participants are not inferred.

concepts.label: Yes
concepts.definition: An affirmative answer, not an inferred sentence affirmation.

concepts.label: No
concepts.definition: A negative answer; distinct from absence, NOT, NONE and NOTHING.

concepts.label: Love (affection)
concepts.definition: Affection as a lexical concept; not ILY, HUG or the complete sentence I love you.

concepts.label: Hello
concepts.definition: Greeting; no reviewed motion currently supplied.

concepts.label: Thank you
concepts.definition: Expression of gratitude; no reviewed motion currently supplied.

concepts.label: I love you
concepts.definition: Complete English expression; legacy illustration is not a validated ASL sentence.

concepts.label: Water
concepts.definition: Water as a liquid, distinct from the verb to water plants.

concepts.label: Family
concepts.definition: A group of relatives; variant and scope require ASL review.

concepts.label: Remember
concepts.definition: Recall or retain a memory; distinct from directional REMIND.

concepts.label: Please
concepts.definition: Polite request marker, distinct from the verb meaning satisfy.

concepts.label: You
concepts.definition: Second-person addressee; signing location/direction and plural distinctions need review.

concepts.label: I / me
concepts.definition: Speaker reference, distinct from the fingerspelled letter I.

concepts.label: Like (enjoy)
concepts.definition: Enjoy or have a preference for; not resemblance or a filler word.

concepts.label: Like (similar)
concepts.definition: Resemblance or comparison; not enjoyment.

concepts.label: Bank (financial)
concepts.definition: A financial institution; not an edge of a river.
exampleContexts: I deposited money at the bank.

concepts.label: Riverbank
concepts.definition: Land at the edge of a river or stream.
exampleContexts: I sat on the river bank.

concepts.label: Light (illumination)
concepts.definition: Visible illumination or a lamp; not low weight.

concepts.label: Light (low weight)
concepts.definition: Having little weight; not illumination.

concepts.label: Right (direction)
concepts.definition: Rightward direction; not correctness or a legal entitlement.

concepts.label: Right (correct)
concepts.definition: Correct or true; not a direction.

concepts.label: Now
concepts.definition: Current time; keeps the phrase right now distinct from rightward/correct.

concepts.label: Friend
concepts.definition: A person with a friendship relationship; source variant is not approved.

concepts.label: Drink
concepts.definition: Consume a liquid; alcohol, container and manner variants require separate review.

concepts.label: Want
concepts.definition: Desire something; not lack, need, or a negated desire.

concepts.label: Need
concepts.definition: Require something; intensity and modality are not inferred from an isolated clip.

concepts.label: Where
concepts.definition: Ask about a location; question nonmanuals are required.

concepts.label: Who
concepts.definition: Ask about a person; not a relative-clause mapping.

concepts.label: When
concepts.definition: Ask about time; not a conditional or relative clause.

concepts.label: Why
concepts.definition: Ask about a reason; not a complete sentence template.

concepts.label: How
concepts.definition: Ask about manner; not quantity, age, or a complete greeting.

concepts.label: Good
concepts.definition: Positive quality; not GOOD-NIGHT, THANK-YOU or a complete evaluation.

concepts.label: Bad
concepts.definition: Negative quality; not a sentence-level negation substitute.

concepts.label: Happy
concepts.definition: A feeling of happiness; facial expression requires review.

concepts.label: Sad
concepts.definition: A feeling of sadness; facial expression requires review.

concepts.label: Work
concepts.definition: Labor or employment; not function correctly, operate, or an artwork.

concepts.label: School
concepts.definition: A place or institution for education; not a group of fish.

concepts.label: Home
concepts.definition: A residence or home; not a sports home team.

concepts.label: Mother
concepts.definition: A mother or female parent; compound family terms require separate mappings.

concepts.label: Sister
concepts.definition: A female sibling; not a religious title or metaphorical relation.

concepts.label: Name
concepts.definition: A name identifying a person; not the verb appoint, and not a name sign for a person.

concepts.label: Know
concepts.definition: Have knowledge; not know-how or sentence-level negation.

concepts.label: Understand
concepts.definition: Comprehend information; not a complete question or a negative statement.

concepts.label: Learn
concepts.definition: Acquire knowledge; not teach or a reviewed inflected sentence.

concepts.label: Go
concepts.definition: Move away or toward a destination; direction and referents require review.

concepts.label: Come
concepts.definition: Move toward a referent; not an invitation sentence template.

concepts.label: Stop
concepts.definition: Cease an action; not a bus stop or a full imperative sentence.

concepts.label: Sorry
concepts.definition: An expression of apology; not sorrow or a complete polite sentence.
